narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the repository structure.
finalText:
**Wrote 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Of 380 commits, 227 were deps, tests, CI and chores. Three breaking items hide in commits labelled `refactor` and `fix`.

| Breaking | Where |
|---|---|
| Internal error types no longer re-exported | `core` `db` `auth` `jobs` `billing` |
| v1 export route removed | `src/api/router.js` |
| Expired token returns `401`, was `403` | `src/auth/token.js` |

One feature: webhook retry with backoff. The latency histogram unit fix will shift dashboard numbers.

Next: check whether webhook retry is on by default in `src/core/config.js`. I guessed yes from the commit stat.
